oracle.statement: with control GET /cluster/telemetry = 200, every leg timeout=1/timeout=2/timeout=60 also returns HTTP 200 with the result envelope object (a 4xx on a documented-legal timeout = Type1_IllegalRejection, 5xx with /healthz alive = Type3_RuntimeFailure); with a 4xx control, every leg answers 4xx uniformly (a 2xx leg = Type1_IllegalSuccess on a face that refuses its documented control read) (constraint qdrant_range_cluster_telemetry_001)
